findings.message: 3 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Bengaluru Open Plot ROI Forecaster" (pill) above "Calculate Your Land Appreciation & Profi"; "Total Purchase Cost" above "₹63.00 Lakhs"; "Projected Value in 3 Years" above "₹99.61 Lakhs"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: ui-monospace — e.g. "BENGALURU • DUBAI", "Channel Partner Registration Verified • "
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: 23 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Open Plots", "Oriaiyan Group", "Open Plots", "D1 Projects").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✈ 🏞 📐 🏡 ✨ 🏢 🌍 🎨
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 10 gradient fill(s): section.relative.pt-12 → linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(200, 163, 77, 0.08) 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 1px), linear-gradient(rgba(200, 163, 77, | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(to top in oklab, rgb(11, 31, 58) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 100%) | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(to top in oklab, rgb(11, 31, 58) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 17 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.bg-white.border → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | button.py-2.5.rounded-xl → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.lg:col-span-5.bg-[#0B1F3A] → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 18 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.bg-[#071527].text-white/80 1440px | section.relative.pt-12 1440px | div.space-y-1.5.pt-2 334px | div.space-y-1.5.pt-2 334px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 35 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 15 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (5, 6 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (section #f8f8f5).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 12px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 145 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: 28% of the first screen is one empty block (540×660px at 900,120).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (265px, 112px, 137px, 153px, 553px, 969px, 1012px); the three most used hold only 57% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Little motion: 8 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Calculate Investment Appreciation Across Corrido" → 3 lines (5 words, 30px); "Looking for a Specific Plot Dimension or Villa C" → 3 lines (9 words, 24px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

at 24px or less.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit 12–15px from the phone's edge: "+91 84319 09508" (12px)
findings.fix: The page margin is 16–20px on a phone; the header and the corner labels sit on it too.
